name: set-after-parse-error-clobbers-file
why: With a syntax error in settings.toml, Settings keeps defaults; any `set` then rewrites the whole file from those values, erasing the user's other edits (budget_day 0.5 becomes 0.05) without warning. The screen can't show the file, so the check is that `set` refuses (and the reload keeps showing the error) instead of saving.
